name: Online Business Builders
_paletteSource: Background #4A5469 and accent #2974ED supplied by the client. Everything else is derived from those two and contrast-checked against them.

_tokenGuide.ink2: card and panel background, one step lighter so cards read as raised
_tokenGuide.ink3: raised surface: table header rows, active chips, hover states
_tokenGuide.inkDeep: recessed wells: code blocks, the data-quality strip backing, inset charts
_tokenGuide.bone: primary text, pure white. 7.6:1 on ink, 6.4:1 on ink2
_tokenGuide.accent: #2974ED is a FILL color on this background, not a text color. Buttons, bars, active chip fills, chart lines, focus rings. White text on it clears 4.4:1
_tokenGuide.accentText: use this tint whenever accent-colored TEXT sits directly on ink or ink2. #2974ED on #4A5469 is only 1.74:1 and is unreadable as text
_tokenGuide.accentDeep: pressed and hover states for accent fills
_tokenGuide.accent2: second data series in charts. Amber, chosen because a second blue is indistinguishable from the accent on a slate background
_tokenGuide.good / warn / alert: solid status colors, for filled chips and bars with white text
_tokenGuide.goodText / warnText / alertText: lighter tints, for status-colored TEXT on ink or ink2

_contrastRule: Status is carried by a FILLED CHIP (solid status color, white text), not by colored text on the slate. The slate background sits mid-tone, so saturated status colors do not clear 4.5:1 as text against it. When text must carry the status (a table cell colored against its goal band), use the *Text tints, never the solid color. Measured on the supplied background: bone 7.6:1, accentText 4.6:1, goodText 5.0:1, warnText 5.2:1, alertText 4.4:1.
_fontNote: Newsreader for headings is the Offer Accelerator client-deliverable standard. If OBB has a brand typeface, swap head and body here, self-host under assets/fonts/, and drop googleImport.
_rules: Rebranding is a token swap in this file only. Never hard-code a color in index.html.
Never use accent #2974ED as text on ink or ink2. Use accentText.
Status colors are semantic. Do not reuse the accent for a status, and do not reuse a status color for a brand element.
No em dashes or en dashes in any board copy. Use commas, colons, or parentheses.
